<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches the Friedel‑Crafts acylation of the anisole chloride to the product where the Cl is replaced by the acyl group from the second precursor. The product SMILES is constructed as COc1cccc(C(=O)NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N)c1. We'll search for templates that break a halide and form an acyl group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(C(=O)NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["acyl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
